newsitem.title: USA: Berger Holdings retains banking firm.
newsitem.headline: Berger Holdings retains banking firm.

text.p: Berger Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday that it had retained investment banking firm First Colonial Securities Group to help achieve its goal of company growth.
Berger, a manufacturer of roof drainage systems, said First Colonial Securities' corporate finance division specializes in small capitalization companies.

"Berger's management has a very aggressive long range goal of growing our company both internally and through additional acquisitions," cheif executive Theodore Schwartz said. "We look forward to this affiliation assisting us to achieve this goal."
